say:2:1041305001:1.text: I once heard a saying, "Everyone's destiny is hidden in the stars."
say:2:1041305001:1.source_cn: 我曾听过一句话，“星空中藏着每个人的命运”。

say:3:1041305002:1.text: Those clear, twinkling stars... This is the guidance of the stars, indicating our destiny, past, present, and future.
say:3:1041305002:1.source_cn: 那些清澈的、闪烁着的星辰辉光——这就是星星的指引，昭示...

say:4:1041305003:1.text: Chippy doesn't understand it, but you do, Lyca. You're amazing!
say:4:1041305003:1.source_cn: 满满听不太懂，但是莱卡能看懂星星的指引，很厉害呢！

say:5:1041305004:0.text: Actually, I can't say I fully understand it myself. Ever since I was a child, I have been attracted by the starlight that occasionally peeks through the canopy.
say:5:1041305004:0.source_cn: 其实……也谈不上完全了解，但我从小就被偶尔从树荫中漏出...

say:6:1041305005:0.text: What is up there in the sky? Why do stars shine so far away? Can travelers really find their way by looking at the stars?
say:6:1041305005:0.source_cn: 天幕上到底有什么呢？星星为什么会在那么遥远的地方闪耀呢...

say:7:1041305006:0.text: Despite it being forever out of reach, I find solace in gazing up at the boundless starry sky, wherever I happen to be.
say:7:1041305006:0.source_cn: 虽然是永远无法触及到的地方，但是我喜欢追随仰望着这片浩...

choice_prompt:8:1041305006.text: Despite it being forever out of reach, I find solace in gazing up at the boundless starry sky, wherever I happen to be.
choice_prompt:8:1041305006.source_cn: 虽然是永远无法触及到的地方，但是我西幻追随仰望着这片浩瀚星空，无论身在何处。

say:9:1041305007:1.text: Yes, it makes me feel at peace.
say:9:1041305007:1.source_cn: 嗯，它能让我感受到纯粹和安宁。

say:10:1041305009:1.text: In the end, "Everyone's destiny is hidden in the stars." I firmly believe that.
say:10:1041305009:1.source_cn: 说到底，“星空中藏着每个人的命运”——我对此深信不疑。

say:11:1041305010:1.text: So, every time you look at the stars, Lyca, are you trying to find your destiny?
say:11:1041305010:1.source_cn: 那么，莱卡每次看星星的时候，是不是也想要从那里找到自己...

say:12:1041305011:1.text: Yes... Although the future cannot be deciphered, I can still find some inspiration from the twinkling stars.
say:12:1041305011:1.source_cn: 是啊。虽然未来不可解读，但我还是从星星的闪烁中读出了一...

choice_prompt:13:1041305011.text: Yes... Although the future cannot be deciphered, I can still find some inspiration from the twinkling stars.
choice_prompt:13:1041305011.source_cn: 是啊。虽然未来不可解读，但我还是从星星的闪烁中读出了一点启示呢。

say:14:1041305012:1.text: It leads to protecting the Dark Forest and everything I cherish. This is all I see.
say:14:1041305012:1.source_cn: 守护——守护薄暮丛林，守护我所珍爱的一切。这是我读出的...

choice:13:0:1.text: So, where will your destiny lead?
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 那么，你的命运将走向何方呢？
choice:13:0:1.male: So, where will your destiny lead?
choice:13:0:1.female: So, where will your destiny lead?

say:16:1041305008:1.text: Maybe... I don't know. The stars may indicate the possibility of a future, but I need to create the future I want for myself.
say:16:1041305008:1.source_cn: 是吗？我不知道，但如果那是真的，星空可能也只是昭示未来...

choice:8:1:2.text: Like a guide to the future.
choice:8:1:2.male: Like a guide to the future.
choice:8:1:2.female: Like a guide to the future.
